title: Better borrowed eyes: each member's MobileNetV3-Small trunk is replaced by an ImageNet-pretrained MobileNetV2 trunk (stronger, wider; BSD-3), read at the same two depths (14x14 and 7x7 at 224 px)
hypothesis: Every gain on the held-out 2024 photograph in this era came from the pretrained trunk, and from nothing else: swapping the from-scratch trunk for ImageNet MobileNetV3-Small took 2024 from 10.75% to 49.5% usable (exp 12), reading two blocks deeper took it to 60.25% (exp 13), style-mixing inside it to 65.5% (exp 14), and showing it the frame at its native 224 px to 74.25% (exp 15, mission 0.293, false fix 3.5%, abstain 22.25%). Eleven experiments that changed the heads, losses, decode and training signal around a from-scratch trunk never left a 6-14% band. The training photographs are already at 98-99% usable at the same held-out viewpoints, so what is missing is not memory but the invariance of the description of a place to a change of survey: exp 15's survey diagnostic shows the within-place variance fraction flat at ~0.235 from epoch 1 to epoch 8 and cross-survey same-place cosine flat at ~0.67. Fine-tuning does not create that invariance; the pretrained features bring it with them, and the network has only ever been given the weakest ImageNet trunk in torchvision (MobileNetV3-Small, 67.7% top-1). MobileNetV2 (71.9% top-1, ~3x wider at the read levels: 96 and 320 channels vs 48 and 96) is the next trunk up and is already cached locally as torchvision IMAGENET1K_V1. The remaining loss is mostly ABSTENTION (22.25% vs 3.5% false fix): the committee's confidence (min member mass on the consensus 3x3 block) falls under 0.3 when a foreign photograph's description lands between prototypes. A trunk whose description of a place moves less between surveys puts more of each member's mass on the right block, converting abstentions into usable fixes. Builds directly on experiments 12-15 (this is exp 12's swap again, one rung higher); everything else in the exp 15 champion is held fixed so the difference is the trunk.
method: In model/model.py, each committee Member's trunk becomes torchvision mobilenet_v2 features[0..17] (stem + all 17 inverted-residual blocks, final 1280-channel 1x1 conv excluded), ImageNet IMAGENET1K_V1 weights baked into a new file model/pretrained/mnv2_features17.pt and loaded strict, fine-tuned at the same 0.1x LR. The place feature reads the same two levels by stride: after features[13] (96 ch, 14x14 at 224 px, stride 16, replacing MNV3-S's 48ch level) and after features[17] (320 ch, 7x7, stride 32, replacing MNV3-S's 96ch level), each through its own 1x1 lift to 56 -> GAP -> concat to the same 112-d feature. MixStyle moves to the stride-equivalent points of the new trunk (after features[3], [6], [10]: stride 4/8/16). Head, committee, decode, losses, augmentation, schedule, epochs and the 128->224 in-graph resize are unchanged. CUDA-only bf16 autocast on the member forward passes is added to keep wall time near the current round (infrastructure, not part of the hypothesis).
expected_outcome: mission_score 0.293 -> ~0.20-0.24 on truedop_2024: usable_fix_rate 74.25% -> ~79-83%, mainly by converting abstentions (22.25% -> ~14-17%), false_fix_rate staying at or below ~4%. Training-capture diagnostics stay at 0.01-0.03. Survey diagnostic: within-place variance fraction (wpv) below exp 15's ~0.235 and xs_cos_same above ~0.67 — if 2024 improves while wpv does not move, the gain came from capacity/memory rather than invariance, which the conclusion must say. Refuted if mission >= 0.293. Exported fp32 ONNX ~16-19 MB (gate 32 MiB); host latency ~25-40 ms (gate 250 ms). Training wall time expected ~1.5-2x exp 15's 35 min.
eli5: The model recognises places using a pair of 'eyes' borrowed from a network that learned to see from a million everyday photos. Each time we gave those borrowed eyes a bigger role, the model got better at recognising Berlin in a photograph it had never seen. This time we swap the smallest such pair of eyes for a sharper, wider one from the same family, so that the same street looks more like itself across different surveys, seasons and shadows, and the model abstains less often.

stages.name: Camera frame
stages.detail: 128×128 px daytime crop, Berlin only; trained on three survey photographs, scored on a fourth it never saw

stages.name: Feature extractor
stages.detail: NEW: the borrowed eyes are upgraded. The 128 px frame is enlarged to 224 px as before, then read by two independent copies of MobileNetV2 (all 17 building blocks, pre-trained on ImageNet, open BSD-3 licence) instead of the smaller MobileNetV3-Small, fine-tuned on Berlin at a tenth of the usual learning rate. Each reads the frame at two depths, both wider than before: a 96-channel 14×14 map (textures and local shapes) and a 320-channel 7×7 map (how roads, roofs and trees are arranged across the frame). Each depth is lifted to 56 numbers and averaged over the frame; the two halves together are the 112-number description of the place

stages.name: Map-cell classifier
stages.detail: each extractor's description is centred, scaled to unit length and compared by angle against one unit-length reference direction per map tile (~3,000 tiles, 128 m each) - a compass, not a lookup table; the angle match times a fixed sharpness (30) is the tile score. The two members' tile-belief maps are averaged to pick the tile

stages.name: Local belief pooling
stages.detail: gathers the averaged belief spread over the winning tile AND its 8 neighbours, and places the fix at the balance point of that local cluster instead of snapping to one tile's centre

stages.name: Within-cell offset
stages.detail: small head per member that nudges the fix from the pooled balance point to the exact spot; the two nudges are averaged

stages.name: Confidence gate
stages.detail: confidence = the SMALLER of the two members' belief on the winning tile plus its 8 neighbours — both navigators must independently back the same place; if either one spreads its belief elsewhere the drone abstains

stages.name: Training signal
stages.detail: unchanged from experiment 15: cross-survey style mixing inside the feature extractor (now after MobileNetV2's 3rd, 6th and 10th blocks, the same image scales as before; training only), angular-margin tile loss, offset loss, paired three-survey batches, re-photographing augmentation, pre-trained blocks at a tenth of the learning rate; targets, epochs and views per epoch unchanged. Training views are enlarged to 224 px exactly as in flight

implementation_brief:
ONE change: swap each Member's pretrained trunk from MobileNetV3-Small features[0..10] to MobileNetV2 features[0..17]. Hold everything else in the exp-15 code fixed.

STEP 0 — bake the weights (one-off, before training; the harness ships model/ incl. model/pretrained/ to the remote trainer, which has NO torch hub cache and must never download):
  Write a tiny throwaway script OUTSIDE model/ (e.g. run inline with .venv/bin/python -c) that does:
    from torchvision.models import mobilenet_v2; import torch
    sd = torch.load(os.path.expanduser('~/.cache/torch/hub/checkpoints/mobilenet_v2-b0353104.pth'), map_location='cpu', weights_only=True)  # torchvision IMAGENET1K_V1, BSD-3
    m = mobilenet_v2(weights=None); m.load_state_dict(sd, strict=True)
    keep = {k: v for k, v in m.state_dict().items() if k.startswith('features.') and int(k.split('.')[1]) <= 17}
    torch.save(keep, 'model/pretrained/mnv2_features17.pt')
  i.e. keys 'features.0.*' .. 'features.17.*' (verbatim torchvision tensors incl. BN running stats; features.18 = the 1280-ch conv is EXCLUDED). Do not delete or modify the existing mnv3s_*.pt / squeezenet files. Make sure the new .pt file is not gitignored (it must be committed with the experiment; it is ~7 MB).

model/model.py:
  - imports: add `from torchvision.models import mobilenet_v2` (mobilenet_v3_small import may go).
  - constants: TRUNK_BLOCKS = 18 (features[:18]); TRUNK_MID_BLOCKS = 14 (h_mid taken after features[13], i.e. when i == TRUNK_MID_BLOCKS - 1 as the existing loop already does); TRUNK_MID_CH = 96; TRUNK_OUT_CH = 320; PRETRAINED_TRUNK_PATH = Path(__file__).parent / 'pretrained' / 'mnv2_features17.pt'; MIXSTYLE_AFTER = (3, 6, 10) (MobileNetV2 stride-4/8/16 points: 24x56x56, 32x28x28, 64x14x14 at 224 px — the same strides as MNV3-S's 1/3/6). Keep EMBED_DIM = 112, LIFT_DIM = 56, INPUT_PX = 224, TRUNK_LR_MULT = 0.1, COS_SCALE = 30, COS_MARGIN = 0.25, MIXSTYLE_P/ALPHA/EPS, CELL_PX, N_MEMBERS = 2 unchanged. Keep IMAGENET_MEAN/STD (MobileNetV2 uses the same normalisation).
  - build_pretrained_trunk(): `trunk = mobilenet_v2(weights=None).features[:TRUNK_BLOCKS]`; load the baked file STRICT with the same 'features.' prefix stripping as now. Assert after loading that the output channel count of the last block is 320 (e.g. run a 1x3x224x224 zeros through it once in a no_grad check, or check trunk[17].out_channels if available) so a wrong slice fails loudly. Called once per member, independent copies, as now.
  - Member.__init__: lift_mid = Conv2d(96 -> 56, 1x1, bias=False) + BN2d + ReLU; lift_deep = Conv2d(320 -> 56, 1x1, bias=False) + BN2d + ReLU (they already read TRUNK_MID_CH / TRUNK_OUT_CH, so updating the constants suffices). Everything else unchanged (embed_bn, prototypes, off_head, MixStyle instance, in_mean/in_std buffers).
  - Member.embed(): unchanged structure — resize 128->224 bilinear in-graph, ImageNet normalise, run blocks one by one, MixStyle after indices in MIXSTYLE_AFTER, h_mid after block TRUNK_MID_BLOCKS-1 (now [B,96,14,14]), h_deep after the last block ([B,320,7,7]). Update the shape comments.
  - CellLocNet, block_mask, forward (committee decode), loss_fn, export_onnx, estimate_position: UNCHANGED.
  - Docstring: append a 'MOBILENETV2 TRUNK (capture-holdout era, experiment 16)' paragraph describing the swap (features[0..17], IMAGENET1K_V1, BSD-3, baked mnv2_features17.pt, read after features[13] 96x14x14 and features[17] 320x7x7, MixStyle after 3/6/10) and fix the Member docstring. Keep the existing contract paragraph.

model/train.py:
  - Imports from model.model stay valid (constants keep their names). MID_HW = INPUT_PX // 16 and DEEP_HW = INPUT_PX // 32 remain correct (14, 7).
  - CUDA-only mixed precision to bound wall time (infrastructure): in run_epoch, wrap ONLY `cos_k, off_k = member(xb_k)` in `torch.autocast(device_type='cuda', dtype=torch.bfloat16, enabled=(device == 'cuda'))`, then immediately cast `cos_k = cos_k.float(); off_k = off_k.float()` so residual_offset_target, loss_fn, softmaxes and stats run in fp32. No GradScaler (bf16 does not need one). On MPS/CPU nothing changes. survey_diag and export stay fp32 (export runs model.cpu() in eval, outside autocast). The `device` variable is a string in train_area; pass it through (run_epoch already receives `device`).
  - Update the log line text and train_info fields that name the trunk: 'init' -> 'pretrained:mobilenet_v2 IMAGENET1K_V1 features[0..17] (torchvision, BSD-3), fine-tuned at 0.1x LR'; 'trunk' / 'capture_sampling' strings -> mobilenet_v2 features[0..17], two-level 96->56 (14x14) + 320->56 (7x7) -> 112, MixStyle after blocks 3/6/10; add 'amp': 'bf16 autocast on member forward (cuda only)' or 'off'. Append a short 'MOBILENETV2 TRUNK (experiment 16)' paragraph to the module docstring.
  - Everything else UNCHANGED: augment_views + AUG, paired-survey interleave, gpu_crops, tent targets, residual offset targets, committee loss sum, optimiser groups (trunk at 1e-3 * TRUNK_LR_MULT, heads at 1e-3, same LambdaLR cosine 1.0 -> 0.1), BATCH_SIZE 64, CHUNK_SIZE, epochs from CLI, survey_diag, trunk BN layers in train mode.
  - Training reads ONLY buckets(meta, 'train'); nothing under model/ may open the eval capture truedop_2024 in any form.

FIXED CONTRACTS (frozen scorer depends on them):
  - train.py CLI: `python -m model.train --area <a> --out-dir <dir> [--data-dir] [--epochs N] [--max-crops-per-bucket N] [--seed N]`; writes <out-dir>/models/<area>.onnx and appends to <out-dir>/train_info.json.
  - ONNX: input 'frame' float32 [1,3,128,128] in [0,1]; output 'uvc' [[u, v, conf]] with u, v normalised map coords in [0,1] and conf in [0,1]; opset 17, dynamo=False; the whole decode lives in-graph; MixStyle must be identity in eval so it never appears in the export.
  - Deployment gates: exported fp32 ONNX <= 32 MiB (expect ~16-19 MB with two members; if it somehow exceeds 30 MB, report it rather than shrinking anything else), host latency <= 250 ms.

Sanity checks before finishing: build the model on CPU, run a 2x3x128x128 batch through CellLocNet.forward and training_outputs, confirm shapes ([2,3]; cos [2,n_cells]; offsets [2,2]); confirm h_mid is [B,96,14,14] and h_deep [B,320,7,7]; export a throwaway ONNX to /tmp and check its file size and that onnxruntime runs it on a 1x3x128x128 input. Do not run full training.
